_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for piercewallar.com career facts. Edit this file, then run:  python scripts/build_career.py
That regenerates js/experience-data.js, data/career-facts.md and the JSON-LD block in index.html. Commit the outputs.
Search this file for EDIT: to find prose still waiting on you. Dates are [year, month]; the end month counts. Use "present" for a current role.
Segment and entry date strings are derived from the numbers, so fix a date once and every output follows.

conventions.army_title_format: Official duty title first, then plain-English phrase after ' | '
conventions.date_format: Mon YYYY (Sep, not Sept); 'Present' for current
conventions.location_format: Joint Base Lewis-McChord, WA (not Fort Lewis)
conventions.header_name: Pierce A. Wallar, PMP (documents); Pierce A. Wallar (site navigation)
conventions.company_names: Newmark (site project page explains the RealFoundations / Newmark RF history)

alumni_of.name: Missouri University of Science and Technology

jsonld.description: MBA candidate at the University of Oklahoma, U.S. Army veteran, and founder of BoomTown Home Services.

entry_order_note: Order = display order on the Experience page: work most recent first, then education oldest first.

entries.label: Ready 3, LLC
entries.summary: An internship with an Oklahoma City defense contractor, applying engineering and project management training to complex aerospace programs.
bullets: Leading development of a facility expansion execution plan for the Engineering function, including the Gantt schedule, work breakdown structure, decision gates, and risk register, tracking 65 deliverables across 7 workstreams in coordination with the Director of Engineering and executive leadership.
Designing a standardized SOP package (template, numbering convention, and 5 to 8 priority procedures) and restructuring the Engineering SharePoint knowledge base so it scales to future projects.
Developing a prioritized RFI process to resolve open scope, site, and approval dependencies ahead of leadership gate decisions.

entries.label: Newmark
entries.summary: Management consulting work in real estate, where the quality of the underlying data decided whether anything built on it could be trusted.
bullets: Merged fragmented ownership records into one interactive online tool, giving the client its first unified view of an ownership structure of 500+ entities.

Standardized roughly 550 real estate entities into a consistent five-digit ID scheme verified against the client's hierarchy diagram; traced and corrected the cause of numbers stored as text that were breaking lookup formulas across thousands of rows, and documented four data quality issues for resolution with the client.

Built a fully formula-driven Excel tool that auto-generates Mermaid.js diagram syntax and plain-English summaries to create standardized, stakeholder-ready swimlane flowcharts; now in use on a second project.

Created Design Confirmation Testing (DCT) scripts for Accounts Payable, Commercial Management, and General Ledger, building branded, formula-linked workbooks that validated data conversion accuracy ahead of a January 2027 go-live.
Built a UAT and DCT testing progress tracker with status roll-ups, charts, and a one-click refresh.

entries.label: Green Tree Risk Group
entries.summary: Early-stage groundwork for an insurtech company built around AI liability and cyber insurance: a managing general agent (MGA) platform paired with AI governance software.
bullets: Coordinated weekly customer discovery interview rounds across a team of six, with more than ten interviews grounding the Business Model Canvas.
Built the six-year financial model from scratch, including partnership structures, a detailed expense build, and a balanced balance sheet, with cell-level source notes for every assumption.
Developed a valuation approach based on public market multiples that values the underwriting and software businesses separately and then combines them.
Led work on market sizing, pricing benchmarks, and the company's name and brand identity, and produced a pitch deck and brand guidelines.
Groundwork concluded in May 2026, when the founding team moved on to other pursuits.
entries.note: Status: groundwork concluded in May 2026, when the founding team moved on to other pursuits.

entries.label: BoomTown Home Services
entries.summary: A veteran-owned home services company serving the Oklahoma City metro, founded shortly after leaving the Army.
bullets: Work across every part of a small business: the services offered, how jobs are scheduled and delivered, customer communication, invoicing, and marketing.
Price against real costs, manage cash flow in a seasonal business, and build repeatable processes so quality does not depend on any one person.

Run as a one-person operation serving roughly 50 or more households a year across routine, seasonal, and one-off residential maintenance and preventive services, scheduling through Google's free tools.

entries.label: Gordian
entries.summary: Capital planning consulting focused on facility assessments and portfolio analysis for clients across sectors.
bullets: Managed 18+ assessments totaling over 80 million square feet across government, higher education, healthcare, K-12, manufacturing, and pharmaceutical sectors; supported capital planning that helped clients secure 4 to 17% increases in annual capital funding.

Directed teams of 3 to 35 professionals delivering facility condition assessments and capital planning models for portfolios from 400,000 to more than 30,000,000 square feet, integrating results into client CMMS/EAM systems.
Identified and eliminated wasteful spending of 8 to 13% through portfolio-level prioritization and lifecycle analysis.
Built repeat business by delivering on time and within 3% of budget baselines where tracked, and by establishing a consistent data model transferable across consulting providers.

entries.label: U.S. Army
entries.place: Active Duty and Oklahoma Army National Guard
entries.summary: Ten years of service: from a part-time cavalry scout in the Oklahoma Army National Guard to an active-duty engineer officer who led soldiers, managed facilities and construction programs, and ran battalion logistics.

segments.name: 19D Cavalry Scout | Reconnaissance
segments.place: A/180 CAV, Oklahoma Army National Guard (part-time)
segments.text: Served as a cavalry scout while completing a bachelor's degree, and responded to Oklahoma natural disasters, including ice storm and tornado cleanup.

segments.name: Engineer Platoon Leader | Engineer Officer
segments.text: Commissioned as an engineer officer through ROTC in May 2016 while working full time in environment, health, and safety, and responded to Oklahoma natural disasters, including ice storm and tornado cleanup.

segments.name: Engineer Platoon Leader | Construction Engineering Leadership
segments.place: A/23 BEB · Joint Base Lewis-McChord, WA
segments.text: Commanded a 28-soldier combat engineer platoon building roads, base camps, and training infrastructure, and raised platoon readiness from 82% to 96% within six months.

segments.name: Engineer Company Executive Officer | Operations & Resource Management
segments.place: B/23 BEB · Joint Base Lewis-McChord, WA
segments.text: Second-in-command of a 120-soldier engineer company: managed a $360K annual budget, introduced inventory and maintenance controls, raised equipment readiness to 95%, and delivered four major construction projects.

segments.name: Deputy Group Engineer | Facilities & Construction Program Management
segments.text: Directed an engineering staff managing $388M in construction, renovation, and maintenance projects, and served as liaison between military and civilian organizations in Asia to modernize 30+ facilities.

segments.name: Battalion Logistics Officer | Logistics & Procurement Program Management
segments.text: Directed a logistics staff overseeing a $350M equipment modernization portfolio and a $15M annual commodity budget, and led the unit to full fielding of new equipment ahead of the Army's schedule.

entries.label: Univar Solutions
entries.summary: First professional role after college, in environment, health, and safety for a global chemical distribution and hazardous waste disposal company.
bullets: Rewrote all company Safety and Health Management System policies, resulting in the re-certification of OSHA's Voluntary Protection Programs (VPP) Star status for 4 chemical plants and 1 petroleum refinery.

Independently performed twice-weekly site safety audits at 4 chemical plants, totaling over 300 audits, while advising executive leadership on programs and initiatives to address current and changing environmental, health, and safety risks.
entries.docs_note: Dropped from the one-page Resume in the 10-26-26 edit; bullets added to CV and site.

bullets: Progressed from day laborer to running entire projects independently: estimating, ordering materials, leading the crew, and completing the job.

bullets: Coursework in construction management and related fields.
Key project: fire, tornado, and egress emergency plan for the campus.
Key project: hearing conservation plan and factory-floor plan for an Oklahoma City manufacturing plant.
Key project: Hazard Communication plan for an Oklahoma City environmental services firm, updated for the 2016 Safety Data Sheet (SDS) changes.
